title: The visual check's verdict on a turn reaches tracy-web (POST /turn/check) as the person who typed and is kept on the turn; a skip is kept by the head of its reason only
steps: S1: Boot the shipped site-tools bundle with a session that knows who typed; run a turn that wrote and whose check says not_shown, then one that wrote nothing.
S2: checkReportOf on a verdict, an unknown verdict, judge-failed with a detail, capture-TIMEOUT, an error, nothing.
S3: POST /turn/check to tracy-web: a verdict, a skip with its note, refused shapes, another turn.
expect: S1: one POST to /api/sites/_conversation/turn/check signed as that person: {turnId: session-a:3, visual: not_shown, note: null}; then {visual: skipped, note: no-write}.
S2: the verdict as is; skipped with judge-failed, capture-TIMEOUT, error; never the detail after the colon.

S3: kept on site_turn.visual / visual_note, the latest word wins; 400 INVALID_TURN, INVALID_VISUAL, INVALID_NOTE; 404 TURN_UNKNOWN for a turn this site does not hold; the column takes only the five verdicts.
evidence: Plan tasks/todo-do-dung-that.md U2: the verdict lived only in one site-tools log line, so nobody could say how often a change was seen on the page
fence: Never awaited by the turn; the skip's detail (it may name a model or a path) stays in the plugin's log

tests: the verdict reaches tracy-web as the person who typed
checkReportOf: a verdict as it is
the verdicts and notes the check door takes
